notes: All figures are computed from Cricsheet ball-by-ball files only; Cricsheet does not cover every match of Dhoni's career, so totals are below official career figures.

Replays: the Jaipur 2005 ODI (Dhoni 183* v Sri Lanka, 2005-10-31) is not in Cricsheet, so no ball-by-ball replay could be built for it; the 2016 World T20 match v Bangladesh in Bengaluru was played on 2016-03-23.
Super-over innings are excluded from batting/keeping/team-score figures.
Balls faced exclude wides; fours/sixes count only boundary hits (Cricsheet non_boundary flag respected).
Keeping: catch = kind 'caught' with Dhoni among fielders; stumping = kind 'stumped'; run-outs counted separately and not included in 'dismissals'.
Batting average = runs / (innings - not outs); 'retired hurt' is treated as not out.
'chasing' = Dhoni batting in the 2nd innings of a limited-overs match or the 4th innings of a Test.

Captaincy is not recorded by Cricsheet; the 'captain' flag is a date-range heuristic (see captaincyRule). Deviation from the brief: the Oct 2011 England-in-India ODIs are treated as Dhoni-captained (Sehwag captained only matches Dhoni missed through suspension, Dec 2011 and Feb 2012, which drop out automatically). IPL 2025: Dhoni treated as captain from 2025-04-11 (first match after Gaikwad's injury).
